Need help with Footprint Check? Email rizwanrasheed046@gmail.com and include your device model, OS version and app version (Settings → Version). We usually reply within 2 business days.

Subscriptions

  • Restore purchases: app → Settings → Restore purchases.
  • Cancel: iPhone/iPad — Settings → your name → Subscriptions. Android — Google Play → Profile → Payments & subscriptions → Subscriptions.
  • Refunds: requested through Apple (reportaproblem.apple.com) or Google Play.
